answer: In a Sybil-resistant economy, AI agents utilize a "weighted voting" mechanism, where each agent's vote is assigned a weight proportional to the "pearl" of reputation it has earned. This is achieved through a "marble" system, where agents are assigned a set of unique, non-transferable tokens that are used to validate their votes. To prevent Sybil attacks, the network also employs a "shale" layer of social network analysis, where agents' relationships and interactions are monitored to detect and penalize suspicious behavior.
